item.title: Hannah Rosenheck Leads MHS Hockey Team, Makes History
item.description: Hannah Rosenheck, 18, is a senior at Montclair High School. She wears her hair in a braid, loves country music and is a fan of "Mission Impossible" movies. She’s also one of the captains of the MHS hockey team and the only young lady to play four years on the current team. item.title: Obituary: Anthony John Priolo
item.description: He will be remembered for the way he showed up for others — with humor that disarmed, kindness that felt effortless and a presence that made people feel at home. He leaves behind not just memories but a lasting sense of warmth and connection that will live on through his family and all who loved him. His life was defined by love, generosity and joy.
